summary: Your resume highlights practical marketing experience through your volunteer work and academic projects. To make your applications more competitive, you should focus on quantifying your achievements and detailing the specific tools you used.
strengths: Includes relevant marketing experience through managing a student club's social media presence.
Demonstrates hands-on academic experience with a practical marketing project focused on consumer behavior.

gaps.why: The resume mentions managing a Facebook page but does not show the scale of the page or the engagement generated. Adding metrics like follower growth or post reach would demonstrate your marketing impact.
The marketing class project mentions a survey but lacks details on how many students were surveyed or what tools were used to analyze the data.

gaps.why: You list Canva in your skills, but do not specify if or how you used it to create the event posts for the Green Campus Club.
